transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I guess… things at work have been feeling off. Like people there, and some vendors, are watching what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look bad. My supervisor says the reports don’t really show that, but I can’t stop thinking it.
Do you believe, despite others telling you otherwise, that these people are definitely plotting against you or trying to make you look bad at work?

Yeah… I mean, I know people keep saying the reports don’t prove it. But I can’t shake it. It really feels like people at work, and some vendors, are tracking what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed things that others around you don’t seem to notice, like voices or presences?

Sometimes… yeah. Like in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting, I’ll hear this man’s voice behind me. It says stuff like, “Move faster, Scott,” or laughs at what I picked. But when I turn around, nobody’s there.
Do you ever experience these voices or other unusual perceptions when you're not at work or around coworkers, like when you're at home or alone?

Not really at home, no… it’s mostly been in work stuff. Like the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting. That’s when I’ll hear the man’s voice behind me, saying to move faster or laughing at what I picked. Then I look and there’s nobody.
Have you ever experienced any strange thoughts, feelings, or perceptions at home or in other places outside of work, like hearing voices or feeling like someone is watching you when you're alone?

Not really when I’m home alone. It’s more… like I said, in the stockroom or driving back from a vendor meeting. I’ll hear a man behind me, telling me to move faster or laughing at what I picked, and then I turn around and there’s nobody there.
Have you ever experienced these kinds of things—like hearing voices or feeling watched—when you're in public places, like stores or restaurants, and not just at work?

Not really in stores or restaurants, no. It’s mostly been in the stockroom or driving back from a vendor meeting… hearing that man behind me, saying “move faster, Scott,” or laughing. Then I look and there’s nobody.

Have you ever had experiences like these—such as hearing voices or feeling like someone is after you—during times when you weren’t at work or in stressful situations, like when you were relaxed at home or out with friends?

Yeah… I guess there was a stretch like that. I wasn’t as wound up, was sleeping more normal, not feeling like I had to handle everything, but… I still thought people were tracking what I was buying for a few weeks. And I’d still hear that voice in the stockroom sometimes.
Have you ever felt like people were watching or tracking you when you weren't at work, such as when you were out running personal errands or spending time with friends?

Yeah… not so much with friends, but when I’m out doing buys or dealing with vendors, I get this feeling they’re tracking what I’m picking up. Like the numbers are being messed with so I look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me the reports, I still… I don’t know, I can’t really shake it.

Have you ever had experiences where you felt people were watching or tracking you, or heard voices, when you weren’t doing work-related tasks at all—like when you were at home, out with friends, or doing personal errands?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed it much when I’m just at home or hanging out. Personal errands… maybe I get uneasy sometimes, but I can’t say it’s the same thing.

Have you ever had times when you were not at work—like when you were at home, out with friends, or doing something you enjoy—where you still felt like people were watching you, tracking you, or trying to make you look bad?

Mostly it’s work stuff. Like… the buys, the vendors. I keep feeling like they’re tracking what I’m ordering or messing with the launch numbers so I look bad. Even when my supervisor shows me the reports, I still can’t really let it go.

Have you ever had times when you were not at work—like when you were at home, out with friends, or doing something you enjoy—where you still felt like people were watching you, tracking you, or trying to make you look bad?

It’s… mostly tied to work. I can’t really shake that people there, and some vendors, are tracking what I’m buying or messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me the reports, it doesn’t really settle it for me.
Have you ever felt like people were watching or trying to harm you when you weren’t at work, like when you were at home, out with friends, or doing something unrelated to your job?

Not really like… harm, no. It’s more the work thing. I keep feeling like people there, and some vendors, are tracking my buys or messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me the reports, I still can’t shake it.

Have you ever had times when you were not at work—like when you were at home, out with friends, or doing something you enjoy—where you still felt like people were watching you, tracking you, or trying to make you look bad?

I mean… not really outside of that. It’s mostly the work thing. I just can’t shake that people there, and maybe some vendors, are tracking my buys or messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me reports, it doesn’t really make it go away.

Have you ever experienced strange thoughts, like people plotting against you, or heard voices when you weren’t at work and weren’t feeling particularly stressed—like during times when you were just going about your day or dealing with normal life challenges?

Yeah… I guess there was a stretch like that. I wasn’t as wound up, I was sleeping more normal, not feeling like I had to run everything… but I still thought people were tracking my buys. And I heard that voice in the stockroom for a few weeks.
Have you ever had experiences where you believed people were plotting against you or heard voices when you weren’t involved in work-related activities or under stress?

Yeah… I mean, there was a calmer stretch. I was sleeping more normal, not feeling like I had to run everything, but I still kept thinking people were tracking my buys. And I heard that voice in the stockroom for a few weeks.
